name: net.twitchboard/twitchboard
title: TwitchBoard
description: Streamer tools: image sizes, name ideas, OBS widgets and bitrate, Twitch/Kick/TikTok earnings.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the TwitchBoard catalog of free browser tools for streamers (Twitch, OBS, YouTube, Discord, TikTok, Kick, stream graphics, name generators). Use it when the user needs to do something hands-on that needs a UI, such as resizing an emote, designing a panel, making a banner or setting up an overlay, and you want to send them to a free tool that does it. Returns matching tools with a one-line description and URL. Leave "query" empty to list a whole category.

query.description: What the user wants to do, e.g. "resize emote", "starting soon screen", "chat overlay".

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return.

tools.name: get_image_size
tools.description: Exact recommended pixel size, aspect ratio, file limits, formats and design tips for streamer images: Twitch emotes, badges, panels, banners, offline screen, profile picture and overlay; YouTube banner, thumbnail and profile picture; Discord emoji, sticker, banner, server icon and avatar; Kick banner; TikTok profile picture; X header. Specs were checked against each platform in October 2026. Pass "asset" for one answer, or only "platform" to list every size for that platform.

asset.description: The image, e.g. "twitch emote", "youtube thumbnail", "discord sticker", "kick banner".

platform.description: Optional platform filter. With no "asset", lists all sizes for it.

tools.name: generate_names
tools.description: Generate random name ideas that already follow the platform's username rules (length, allowed characters, underscores): Twitch channel names, generic gamertags, Minecraft, Roblox, Discord usernames, Discord server names, Fortnite (Epic) display names, Valorant Riot IDs, Xbox gamertags and clan names with tags. Use it when the user asks for name ideas; offer to generate more or switch style. Availability is not checked: use check_username for Minecraft or Roblox.

platform.description: Where the name will be used. "gamertag" works on most platforms.

style.description: Vibe of the names: gamer (Gamer), cute (Cute & cozy), dark (Dark & edgy), funny (Funny), fantasy (Fantasy), minimal (Minimal / pro), sweaty (Sweaty / competitive), blocky (Blocky / crafting), clan (Clan / team), community (Community). Each platform supports a subset; defaults to its first style.

keyword.description: Optional word to build names around, e.g. the user's nickname or favourite game character (letters and numbers only).

max_length.description: Optional maximum length; capped at the platform maximum.

numbers.description: Allow numbers at the end of some names.

separators.description: Allow separators such as _ or spaces where the platform permits them.

tools.name: check_username
tools.description: Check whether a Minecraft (Java Edition) or Roblox username is available, using the platforms' official lookups. Returns available, taken (with a profile link) or invalid (with the reason). Pair it with generate_names to find a free name. Results are cached for a minute.

tools.name: create_obs_widget
tools.description: Build a ready-to-paste Browser source URL for OBS, Streamlabs, Meld or TikTok LIVE Studio: a countdown (fixed length or until a date), a stream uptime timer, a clock in any time zone, or a goal progress bar (manual value or live TikTok follower count). Widgets are transparent, free and keep all settings in the URL, so nothing is stored. Returns the URL, the source width and height, setup steps and a link to fine-tune it visually.

minutes.description: countdown: length in minutes (default 5). Ignored when "until" is set.

until.description: countdown: count down to this ISO 8601 date-time with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-12-31T20:00:00-05:00.

label.description: countdown / stream_timer: text above the time, e.g. "Starting soon" or "Live for".

end_text.description: countdown: text shown when it reaches zero (default "We're live!").

show_days.description: countdown / stream_timer: show days for long durations.

hide_at_end.description: countdown: hide the widget when it ends.

timezone.description: clock: IANA time zone such as "Europe/Warsaw". Defaults to the computer running OBS.

show_timezone.description: clock: show the time zone name.

current.description: goal_bar: current number for a manual bar.

tiktok_username.description: goal_bar: follow a TikTok account's live follower count instead of a manual number.

font.description: Google Font for the text (default Inter).

accent_color.description: countdown: progress bar colour; goal_bar: bar start colour.

tools.name: get_stream_settings
tools.description: Recommend OBS output settings for live streaming: video bitrate, audio bitrate, rate control, keyframe interval, resolution, frame rate and encoder preset, based on the platform's published recommendations, how much motion the content has and the user's upload speed. Warns when the upload speed or the platform cap forces a lower bitrate.

platform.description: "other" means another platform or local recording.

motion.description: low: Just Chatting, art, strategy; normal: most games; high: shooters, racing.

encoder.description: nvenc (NVIDIA), amf (AMD), qsv (Intel), x264 (CPU), apple (Apple VT).

tools.name: style_text
tools.description: Convert plain text into Unicode "font" styles that paste anywhere fonts can't be changed: Discord and Twitch chat, usernames, bios, stream titles. Styles: bold (Bold), italic (Italic), bolditalic (Bold italic), sansbold (Sans bold), sansitalic (Sans italic), sansbolditalic (Sans bold italic), script (Script), boldscript (Bold script), fraktur (Gothic), boldfraktur (Bold gothic), double (Double-struck), mono (Monospace), smallcaps (Small caps), superscript (Tiny (superscript)), wide (Wide (aesthetic)), circled (Bubbles), negcircled (Dark bubbles), squared (Squares), negsquared (Dark squares), strike (Strikethrough), underline (Underline), slash (Slashed), upside (Upside down). Leave "style" empty to get every style at once. Screen readers read these characters poorly, so suggest plain text for important information.

tools.name: discord_timestamp
tools.description: Make Discord timestamp codes like <t:1767225600:F> that show a date and time in every reader's own time zone, for event announcements and stream schedules. Pass an ISO 8601 date-time with its UTC offset (e.g. "2026-12-31T20:00:00-05:00") or a Unix timestamp in seconds. Returns all seven formats.

time.description: ISO 8601 date-time including the UTC offset or Z, or Unix seconds. Ask the user for their time zone if it isn't known.

tools.name: estimate_twitch_earnings
tools.description: Estimate a Twitch streamer's monthly and yearly income from paid subs (tiers 1–3), Prime subs, Bits and ads, using the same formula as the TwitchBoard sub calculator. Defaults use US prices ($5.99 / $9.99 / $24.99), a 50% sub split, $2.50 per Prime sub, $0.01 per Bit and a $3.50 ad CPM. These are estimates; actual payouts vary by country, contract and ad fill.

avg_viewers.description: Average concurrent viewers, used for ad revenue.

hours_per_month.description: Hours streamed per month, used for ad revenue.

revenue_split.description: Streamer share of sub revenue: 0.5 standard, 0.7 Partner Plus.

ad_cpm.description: Streamer ad revenue per 1,000 ad impressions, in USD.

tools.name: estimate_kick_earnings
tools.description: Estimate a Kick streamer's monthly sub income with Kick's 95/5 split, compared with a 50/50 split. Gifted subs count as subs.

subs_per_month.description: Subs per month, including gifted subs.

tools.name: estimate_tiktok_earnings
tools.description: Estimate a TikTok creator's monthly income from Creator Rewards views, LIVE gifts (diamonds) and brand deals. TikTok publishes none of these rates, so every rate is an editable assumption: $0.50 per 1,000 qualified views, $0.005 per diamond and $10 per 1,000 followers per sponsored post by default.

qualified_views.description: Qualified Creator Rewards views per month.

usd_per_1000_followers.description: Brand deal rate per sponsored post (assumption).

tools.name: convert_tiktok_coins
tools.description: Convert TikTok coins (or a gift's coin price) to what the viewer pays in USD and roughly what the creator receives. Default coin price is a 100-coin pack for $1.29 and a 50% creator share; both are editable because TikTok prices vary by country and platform.

coins.description: Number of coins, or the coin price of a gift.

pack_size.description: Coins in the pack the viewer bought.

pack_price.description: Price of that pack in USD.

creator_share.description: Share of the gift value the creator receives (assumption).
